svg.title: Application layout: board with sidebar and page header
svg.desc: The conventional application layout of decision D9. A 240 px left navigation sidebar lists Boards (current), Explore with Metrics and Logs, and Admin, and collapses to a 56 px icon rail. A 56 px page header shows the breadcrumb Boards, Payments overview on the left and, on the right, the command palette entry, the time range picker set to Last 1 hour with the UTC time zone, the refresh control set to 30 s, and the user menu. The board below has 24 px padding and 16 px gaps on a 12-column grid: four stat panels (requests, error rate failing, p99 latency degraded, Apdex), a POST /pay p99 latency time series with the 12:19 config change marker, a psp-api call-duration heatmap with a 2.0 s ceiling, a log volume chart stacked by level, and a log stream. Callouts: 1 sidebar, 2 page title, 3 time range and refresh, 4 user menu, 5 board grid spacing.
